verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order and grouping: the 'Try It' CTA moves to the far left before the headline, and the NEW badge collides with its top edge. The product can is pushed to the right edge, tiny and without its cream circle backdrop. B keeps the original left-to-right sequence (can, headline/subhead, NEW, Try It), but the subhead is so small it is barely readable at 320x50, the can fills the full height with no breathing room and has lost its circle, and the NEW pill crowds the headline.
